subject: Aurelia Health — evidence & operator-access sprint proposal
messages:
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@aureliahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurelia Procurement <procurement@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP follow-up — operator access & acceptance evidence

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. Procurement and our engineering team reviewed the RFP and we have a few follow-up asks specific to on-prem / VPC-hosted deployments before we can proceed to the security panel: 

- Operator access matrix: roles, minimum required privileges, and separation of duties for on-call operators.
- Evidence for key management: KMS/HSM integration approach, attestation or third-party audit summary.
- Network diagram boundaries showing egress controls and permitted telemetry.
- Maintenance and patch windows, plus rollback/playback procedures.
- Sample operator handoff checklist and runbook excerpt used during initial installs.

Attached is the latest PDF of our RFP with inline line-items highlighted (aurelia_rfp_v3.pdf). Can Redwood provide an acceptance evidence plan (what artifacts you will provide, in what order) and a short sprint-style timeline for us to review? We are aiming to complete technical acceptance and procurement by end of July.

Best,
Samir

--
Samir Shah
Head of IT Security, Aurelia Health
samir.shah@aureliahealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — operator access & acceptance evidence

Samir — thanks for the clear list and the PDF. I looped in Laura (solutions) and Tessa (field ops) — they will own the artifacts and the operator checklist respectively.

High-level plan we can commit to this week: 
1) We’ll map each RFP line-item to an artifact and owner (Laura).
2) Tessa will prepare an operator-access matrix + runbook excerpt and mark anything that requires an SLA exception.
3) We’ll deliver a documented KMS integration summary and a filled attestation template.
4) Mutual action plan (deliverables + dates) by EOD Monday so you can circulate to procurement.

Proposed working session: Tuesday 2028-06-20 10:00am PT to walk the acceptance artifacts and agree success criteria. Is that OK with your engineering lead?

Attachments: — I will attach the initial mutual action plan and operator matrix after Laura and Tessa make a pass.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Shah <samir.shah@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-19T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — operator access & acceptance evidence

On Mon, Jun 18, 2028 at 11:03 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Samir — thanks for the clear list and the PDF. I looped in Laura (solutions) and Tessa (field ops) — they will own the artifacts and the operator checklist respectively.
> 
> High-level plan we can commit to this week: ...

Thanks all — I drafted the artifact mapping and started the KMS attestation template. Summary below: 

Artifact mapping (deliverable -> what we'll attach):
- Operator access matrix -> operator_matrix.xlsx (with roles: operator, lead_operator, install_engineer, auditor)
- Runbook excerpt -> runbook_install_excerpt.txt (we will paste the excerpt into the Drive, redacting any customer-sensitive examples)
- KMS/HSM summary -> kms_attestation_template.docx (includes supported KMS providers, encryption-at-rest patterns, key rotation cadence)
- Network boundary diagram -> network_boundary_diagram.pdf (redwood-generated diagram of egress allowed endpoints)
- Maintenance windows & rollback playbook -> maintenance_playbook_snippet.pdf

I have two asks for Aurelia in the working session: 
1) Confirm the specific KMS/HSM vendor you want us to integrate with (if any) so we can attach sample config snippets.
2) Confirm if you require operator audit logs to be retained beyond 12 months (we have configurable retention policies).

I attached the working draft artifacts: operator_matrix.xlsx and kms_attestation_template.docx (see attachments summary). Tessa — can you add an operator handoff checklist to operator_matrix?

Laura Bennett
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: Samir Shah <samir.shah@aureliahealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aurelia Procurement <procurement@aureliahealth.com>, Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — operator access & acceptance evidence

Thanks Laura — that mapping is exactly what we wanted. Quick clarifications before Tuesday: 

- KMS: primary is Azure Key Vault; we also have legacy HSM-backed keys from our CA. If Redwood can document both integration paths that would be ideal.
- Retention: security policy requires operator audit logs retained 24 months for our environment. Please confirm if Redwood can support 24 months.
- For procurement: I’ve attached our commercial intake link (DocuSign) — procurement will need the mutual action plan to include milestone acceptance gates tied to payment tranches.

Also, can you indicate which artifacts will contain sensitive information requiring access control in the Drive link you mentioned? Procurement will want a list to include in our access request.

Samir

--
Samir Shah
Head of IT Security, Aurelia Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@aureliahealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Aurelia Procurement <procurement@aureliahealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-22T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up — operator access & acceptance evidence

Folks — following the working session today, attached is the agreed mutual action plan (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx) with acceptance gates, deliverable owners and proposed dates. Highlights / commitments: 

- Operator audit retention: Redwood will configure operator audit logs retention to 24 months for the Aurelia tenant (configurable flag). Pending contractual SLA confirmation.
- KMS integration: we will provide two artifacts: a) Azure Key Vault integration guide with example config snippets; b) HSM-backed key guidance (platform-level recommendations + supported HSM vendors).
- Operator access: operator_matrix.xlsx now includes the handoff checklist and a list of actions that require explicit approval.
- Drive governance: the Drive folder will be access-controlled. Items marked CONFIDENTIAL (runbook excerpts that contain operational secrets) will only be available to named Aurelia users via Google SSO and RBAC. Link: https://redwood-drive.example.com/shared/Aurelia-Evidence
- Procurement: I added milestone acceptance language that ties the second payment tranche to acceptance gate #2. DocuSign link provided by Aurelia is captured in the plan.

Next steps for us: deliver final PDF artifacts (network diagram + maintenance snippet) by Friday 2028-06-24. I also created a dedicated Slack channel for quick operator coordination (will share invite separately).

If there are any redlines to the mutual action plan, please send them by Wednesday 2028-06-28 so we can incorporate before the procurement review.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments referenced: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v1.xlsx, operator_matrix.xlsx, kms_attestation_template.docx
